note: Idaho Code 50-402 sets the municipal general election on the first Tuesday after the first Monday in November of each odd-numbered year, when all mayors are chosen. Boise elected mayors in 2011, 2015, 2019 and 2023, so no mayoral election fell in an even-numbered year. The Ada County results index lists no Boise mayoral election in this year.
